32: def totalRho (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, F.rho i t
33: def totalPressure (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, F.w i*F.rho i t
34: def enthalpy (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, (1+F.w i)*F.rho i t
35: def wEff (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := F.totalPressure t/F.totalRho t
36: def correctedRho (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (c : TGLCoupling) (i : ι) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
37:   (1+c.beta*(1+F.w i))*F.rho i t
38: def correctedTotalRho (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (c : TGLCoupling) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
39:   ∑ i, F.correctedRho c i t
40: def correctedTotalPressure (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (c : TGLCoupling) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
41:   ∑ i, F.w i*F.correctedRho c i t

48: theorem sector_rescaling_preserves_continuity (F : SectorFluid ι I H)
49:     (c : TGLCoupling) (i : ι) (t : ℝ) (ht : t∈I) :
50:     HasDerivAt (F.correctedRho c i)
51:       (-3*H t*(1+F.w i)*F.correctedRho c i t) t := by
52:   convert! (F.H_sector_nonexchange i t ht).const_mul (1+c.beta*(1+F.w i)) using 1
53:   dsimp [correctedRho]

100:       3*H t*(F.correctedTotalRho c t+F.correctedTotalPressure c t) = 0 := by
101:   rw [(F.corrected_rho_deriv c t ht).deriv]

104: /-- Total positivity and nonnegative enthalpy are the exact domain of this reading. -/
105: theorem effective_enthalpy (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (t : ℝ)
106:     (hr : 0 < F.totalRho t) (he : 0 ≤ F.enthalpy t) :
107:     F.totalRho t*|1+F.wEff t| = F.enthalpy t := by
108:   have hw : 1+F.wEff t = F.enthalpy t/F.totalRho t := by
109:     rw [F.enthalpy_eq]
110:     unfold wEff
111:     field_simp
112:   rw [hw, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg he hr.le)]
113:   field_simp

115: theorem multiplicative_closure (F : SectorFluid ι I H) (c : TGLCoupling)
116:     (t : ℝ) (hr : 0 < F.totalRho t) (he : 0 ≤ F.enthalpy t) :
117:     F.correctedTotalRho c t = F.totalRho t*(1+c.beta*|1+F.wEff t|) := by
118:   rw [F.corrected_closure, ← F.effective_enthalpy t hr he]
119:   ring

122: theorem three_sector_closure (c : TGLCoupling) (rhoR rhoM rhoL : ℝ) :
123:     (rhoR+rhoM+rhoL)+c.beta*((rhoR+rhoR/3)+(rhoM+0)+(rhoL+(-rhoL))) =

125:   rw [TGLExt.closure_identity c.beta rhoR rhoM rhoL]
126:   exact TGLExt.hubble_form c.beta rhoR rhoM rhoL
